# Vex Video Editing Agent

## Authority tier

Tier B

## Status

useful-after-audit

AKMessi / vex.

## URL

https://github.com/AKMessi/vex

## Last checked

## Scope

Implementation ideas for shot-aware automatic grading: frame statistics, scene/shot
decisions, bounded candidate generation, continuity penalties, subject protection, and
preview evaluation.

## Why trusted

The repository exposes real implementation code for its grading planner rather than only
a marketing description. The inspected implementation models shot ranges, luma and
saturation statistics, clipping, neutral/skin fractions, candidate grades, continuity
penalties, and a rendered filter graph.

## Caveats

This is an implementation lead, not a color-science standard. The repository uses a
non-standard/unspecified license in GitHub metadata, so mine concepts and independently
implement them unless license terms are explicitly cleared.

## Extracted rules

- Analyze representative frames per shot rather than one global frame sample.
- Generate several bounded correction candidates and score them.
- Penalize unnecessary discontinuity between neighboring shots.
- Protect skin and clipping from aggressive automatic correction.
- Persist the selected candidate and evidence in a manifest.

## Do not use this source for

Copying implementation code without license review, or as an authority on ACES/OCIO.
